top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, independently replicated discovery arc: proglucagon processing and the incretin effect (Holst), proglucagon-derived peptides and receptor biology (Drucker), and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov). It is mature, with outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. The physiology-anchored citation, which says the discoveries made incretin-based treatment possible, avoids crediting analogue design. The weak points are Mojsov's disputed priority against Habener and the omission of Knudsen, but these affect the third name and not whether the achievement merits a prize, so it clearly ranks above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Drucker, Holst, Mojsov, Knudsen or Habener
